{{Quote|Security Directive 101-3A. I hereby approve the application of Castellan restraints to designate Cipher Nine.|Minister of Intelligence|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Security Directive 101-3A''' was issued by the [[Minister of Intelligence (Galactic War)|Minister of Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in [[3642 BBY]] and allowed for [[Castellan restraints]] to be applied to the [[Cipher Agent|Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]].
